note: Static one-time snapshot, not auto-refreshed. difficulty is a 1-10 community rating. itemHours is per-item expected hours (drop-rate attempts / iron KPH, on-task rate for slayer bosses) where available; activityHours (coarser: baseline hours to your next item from that whole source) is used as a fallback. requiresPrevious flags items gated behind a prerequisite item, where the hours figure understates true time. Scurrius' spine (id 1488) is a manual addition: this spreadsheet doesn't cover Scurrius at all, so itemHours was computed directly from the OSRS Wiki's 1/33 MVP drop rate and TempleOSRS's Iron EHB solo KPH of 70; no community difficulty rating exists for it.
